en.meta_title: idle() — AI lo-fi & healing music for tired developers · ipe(); // be still
en.meta_desc: idle() is the music of ipe() — AI lo-fi & healing music for tired developers and late-night focus. 12 tracks on YouTube in English & Korean, including the debut album dear(you); vol.1.
en.hero_h:
Music for the moment
the code rests
en.hero_sub: At the end of a tiring day — it's okay to pause for a while.
en.player_desc:
letters to you,
who made it through today
en.moods_h: What kind of rest do you need?
en.feat_desc:
letters to you,
who made it through today
en.app_title:
Lo-fi that flows
with your own time
en.story1_p: idle() is music for the moment your work pauses. Between focus and rest — it stays beside you, without too much explanation.
en.story2_p: It connects a developer's language with warm sound. A small player that hands the next breath to the one who made it through today.
en.album_note: Every track is on YouTube in English and Korean — pick a version in the player above.
en.u001_desc: The first ipe() single — bright, hopeful lo-fi.
en.n001_desc: Lo-fi for the night you couldn't leave before the build finished.
en.journal_sub: Behind the music, and other quiet updates.
en.journal_empty: The first post is coming soon.
en.how_tag: // produced with AI, reviewed by a person
en.how_p1: The music is produced with AI (Suno), openly and transparently. Lyrics are AI-drafted and reviewed by a person.
en.how_p2: Since the dear(you); album, every track closes with a quiet spoken signature — “ipe. be still” — a single breath, whispered.

ko.meta_title: idle() — 지친 개발자를 위한 AI 로파이·힐링 음악 · ipe(); // be still

ko.album_note: 모든 곡은 YouTube에 영어·한국어 두 버전으로 있어요. 위 플레이어에서 버전을 고를 수 있어요.
ko.u001_desc: ipe()의 첫 싱글 — 밝고 희망찬 로파이.
ko.n001_desc: 빌드가 끝나기 전엔 퇴근할 수 없던 밤을 위한 로파이.
ko.how_p1: 음악은 AI(Suno)로 만들고, 그 사실을 숨기지 않습니다. 가사는 AI 초안을 사람이 검토합니다.
ko.how_p2: dear(you); 앨범부터 모든 곡은 「ipe. be still」이라는 짧은 속삭임으로 끝납니다 — 숨 한 번, 조용히 건네는 한 줄입니다.
